criteria.requirement: BRAVO 1/2 use only the measured source-specific absolute BAR events; no every-four-BAR repetition remains.
BAR 65+ events are read by absolute BAR and never alias to BAR 1-64 or manual state.
Init/manual 64-BAR slots, state IDs, XY, UI, latency and existing effects are unchanged.
The immutable schedule adds no audio-thread allocation, lock, ValueTree, I/O or logging.
Focused deterministic tests cover selected, empty, BAR 65+ and non-aliasing cases; existing relevant tests still run.
